body_markdown: Pure Molybdenum – a work of art! The wide variety and purity of metals Titan handles always keeps work interesting. This Moly plate with very low oxygen is headed for a specialty application. Titan carries many types of molybdenum materials, including melt stock, powders, pellets and oxide. Let us know your Moly needs, Titan is the high quality “van Gogh-to” for both term agreements and spot purchases.
